codeReview.summary: The follow-up fix closes the original blocking gap. The updated department-scope mixed canonical-blocked test now explicitly verifies that the unrelated Infrastructure goal card clears its blocked-owner signal and switches to the zero-row empty-state treatment once Governance narrowing removes all matching rows, repeats that assertion after the permit search, and still verifies reset restores the broader overview blocked-owner state. That directly covers the stale blocked-owner leakage scenario called out in the prior failed review.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Manual agent-browser verification could not reliably force the dashboard onto deterministic fixture data because network-route mocking did not consistently override the live Google Sheets request. Future workers validating fixture-specific UI behavior manually may hit the same gap unless this limitation or an alternative manual-fixture path is documented.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Fix handoff for worker session e5a4972f-d229-4b9f-9c1b-e1dfcf29d6a6 records discovered issue: 'agent-browser network-route mocking did not reliably override the live Google Sheets request during manual verification, so deterministic behavior confirmation relied on Playwright fixture tests rather than interactive mock-driven browser checks.'
